payload.title: File:Archaeopteryx timeline.svg
payload.description_html:
Timeline on Archaeopteryx. Mainly according to the informations described in en:w:Archaeopteryx. (This timeline is not completed yet, because it needs completion of informations and verification)

  • black dots:years described.
  • green text:nomen oblitum 1961 per ICZN Opinion 607.
  • blue part of the bars: known as other species.
  • green part of the bars: personal collection / inaccessible.
